mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% signals labor market weakness, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 99.0, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which is particularly bearish for equities during a supply shock regime, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 99.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 750.0, it signals a contraction in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 750.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).
